title: DynamicLH2PoolX
description: Time-dependent liquid-hydrogen spreading and evaporation for declared ground inflow. This release candidate preserves the v0.2.0.dev0 numerical methods and adds a frozen post-shutoff research dataset, reproduction scripts, full source snapshots, model equations and explicit evidence scope. JUEL held-out radius RMSEs are 0.1374 m and 0.1016 m. HSE end radius and reported-front disappearance are 0.92 m and 19 s; the full radius trajectory is not reproduced. Liquid inventory and evaporation histories remain model predictions.
